segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to do a quick handoff check before your kickoff. I have you at 60 seats to start, go-live August 26, and the standard business-hours support plan.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. Small thing, the calendar invite from your implementation manager says 52 seats. We added the eight ops users before signature, so I just don't want them blocked on day one.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, good catch. I'll get that cleaned up today so provisioning is set for 60. No issue on our side.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And for data import, we're sending the customer list and open tickets by Friday. Your team said CSV is fine, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: CSV is fine. If you can keep the fields to the template, they can usually turn it in two business days. Do you still want a dry run the week of August 12?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, August 14 if you have it. Also, the first invoice showed quarterly billing. Our PO is for annual upfront, $48,600, net 30. Finance kicked it back this morning.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Ah, sorry about that. I'll have billing reissue it as annual upfront and reference PO 4179. You should see the corrected copy by tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Last thing, legal is asking whether the renewal notice is 60 days or 90 days.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It's 60 days. I'll send the final order form and the updated kickoff details after this, and we'll keep August 26 as the target.
